text:
mike: Deploybot alert just flagged a spike in OOMs for quantized model 'redwood-quant-v2' on dedicated eu-west1. Error rate + tail latency up in canary. I want to push a fastpatch that pins to v2.1.3-quant-fix and applies a KV-cache bounds guard. Need expedited approval from releases + ml-infra + oncall.
priya: saw the same in prod metrics. Can confirm canary replicas 3/5 hit OOM within 30m after traffic increase.
jordan: are we confident the kv bounds change is a one-line safe change? any perf regression risk?
kevin (ml-infra): it's a tiny guard: cap cache keys per-request to 8 and early-evict large prefixes. Should avoid OOMs. I ran perf on staging with 6k tokens — no perf regression on 95th pct.
tess (oncall): what's the rollback plan if this makes latency worse? need clear criteria before I ack.
mike: rollback if 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 5min OR p95 latency > 200ms above baseline for 10min. Also will auto-fallback to 'redwood-quant-v2-legacy' if deploybot marks degraded.
priya: +1 for expedited. this is impacting EU dedicated tenants.
jordan: +1 but ask to keep canary at 5% for 10min before ramp.
kevin (ml-infra): I'm adding the image pin and config bump now. deploy command:```bash
deploybot release start --service=ml-serving --model=redwood-quant-v2 --image=redwood-quant:v2.1.3-quant-fix --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --auto-rollback=false --meta="expedite:oom-kv-guard"
```
releasebot: @mike created release 2026.03.17-quant-fix (id r-20260317-07). Release notes draft: "Fix KV cache bounds causing OOMs on quantized v2 in high-length requests; pins model image to v2.1.3-quant-fix; adds safety eviction."
priya: small release note OK. Also add ops contact + rollback criteria.
mike: added rollback criteria to the release notes and to the deploy command metadata. Anyone object to skipping our regular 30m full canary given the OOM severity?
jordan: I prefer 10min 5% then 30% then full. but if oncall sees severe errors we can stop early.
tess (oncall): I'll watch real-time and will call rollback if criteria exceed. monitor dims: 5xx_rate, p95_latency, gpu_memory_free.
kevin (ml-infra): image pushed and pinned to registry. Patch PR merged: `fix/kv-cache-guard` -> main. Release tag r-20260317-07.
deploybot: Starting canary rollout: r-20260317-07 -> 5% in eu-west1. Tracking tasks: [provision], [deploy], [smoke].
mike: thumbs up. tagging legal/compliance not required for this tiny runtime guard.
priya: adding release note short blurb in the ticket and linking to customer-facing status for impacted EU tenants.
releasebot: Release r-20260317-07 status: canary started. Notes: contact oncall tess.
10m_live_check (tess): canary 5% for 10m completed. no 5xx spike, p95 +8ms, gpu mem stable. recommend ramp to 30%.
jordan: ack ramp to 30%.
deploybot: Ramp to 30% in eu-west1 initiated.
mike: I'll watch for 30m. if no regression we'll complete the rollout and update release notes + changelog. Thanks all for quick consensus :thumbsup:
releasebot: r-20260317-07 rollout complete to eu-west1 100%.
kevin (ml-infra): post-rollout sanity: OOMs down to baseline, p95 stable. rolling back not required.
tess (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. I'll leave extra monitoring for 24h. If anyone needs to pin back to legacy for a specific customer, raise a support ticket.
priya: need a one-line summary for the status page: "Hotfix deployed: KV-cache guard applied to redwood-quant-v2 (v2.1.3-quant-fix) — mitigated EU OOMs; no user-visible regression."
mike: posted to #customer-status and internal release notes updated with timeline.
releasebot: release r-20260317-07 closed. changelog entry added.
deploybot: logs archived at s3://releases/r-20260317-07/logs
mike: thanks team. follow-up: kevin will file a follow-up item to add automated kv-bounds tests to CI.
kevin (ml-infra): filed ticket INFRA-1249.
priya: closing thread from releases side.
